cohort: 464 women who underwent elective caesarean section at National Hospital Organization Kofu National Hospital, Japan between January 2011 and May 2019.
finding: The absence of uterine contractions on a 40-min CTG performed within 6 hours before elective caesarean section was significantly associated with an increased risk of TTN after controlling for gestational diabetes mellitus, small for gestational age, male sex and caesarean section at 37 weeks.
mod_finding: The absence of uterine contractions prior to elective caesarean section was significantly associated with an increased risk of transient tachypnoea of the newborn.
gest_age: Term (exclusion criteria included elective caesarean section before term)
